answer: The opal ledger records every attestation, and any wallet joining through the same inlet as an existing staker is flagged. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bond locked behind a slow-release bridge contract, where withdrawal waits one epoch and forfeits to the community on proven duplicate identity. Attacker cost: capital locked per identity plus forfeited bonds, making mass fake accounts prohibitively expensive. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
